Otter Chat & Quick Search

 Press **⌘/Ctrl + K** to open the search bar to ask Otter Chat or search for conversations.

Manage Otter Notetaker Settings

 All Notetaker settings (e.g., **auto-share**, **auto-join**) can be managed in **[Account Settings → Meetings](https://otter.ai/setting/share-notes?utm_source=help_center&utm_medium=homepage&utm_campaign=tips)**.

Record Botless

 Download our **[Desktop app](https://otter.ai/integrations/desktop?utm_source=help_center&utm_medium=homepage&utm_campaign=tips)** to record meetings without Notetaker.
